_comment:
Reference map legend per ADR 0054 Phase 3. Top-down semantic camp layout for cozy survival games. Mirrors aldenmere's camp scenario (fire pit, hut, market, drying rack, river, forest, paths, berry bushes, rocks). Per-game legends can override colors, drop entries, or add new ones. Each entry has a `kind`: anchor (discrete entity at centroid) / zone (continuous mask) / path (skeletonized polyline).

Garden DROPPED 2026-05-19 after empirical Lab-distance failures: dark olive #508030 was 21 Lab from forest #2a5a2a (collision); wheat-gold #c0b070 was 12 Lab from path #c8a878 (collision). Per-game legends needing a distinct garden anchor should pick a color verified distant from ALL existing entries (NOT just forest). Aldenmere's anchor_to_def already mapped garden→food_berry_bush, so dropping is no-op for that game.
name: map_camp_default

entries.name: background
entries._comment: Out-of-bounds. Dark neutral. Excluded from emit but kept in legend so quantization absorbs the cluster.

entries.name: grass
entries._comment: Open clearing / walkable grass. Large continuous region (the camp interior + outside-the-camp open spaces). Most other anchors must sit on grass.

entries.name: forest
entries._comment: Dense forest. Continuous region around the clearing. Tree patterns scatter inside this mask in the compiled output.

entries.name: water
entries._comment: River / pond. Continuous region. Anchors on water are flagged as invalid.

entries.name: path
entries._comment: Dirt path / road. Skeletonized to a polyline in extracted output. Tan/sand color.

entries.name: fire_pit
entries._comment: Central camp fire. Anchor at centroid. Yellow.

entries.name: hut
entries._comment: Player's cabin / shelter. Red-brown. Anchor at centroid; rotation inferred to face fire_pit by downstream rule.

entries.name: drying_rack
entries._comment: Storage / drying rack. Orange. Anchor at centroid.

entries.name: storage
entries._comment: Storage chest / pile. Purple. Anchor at centroid.

entries.name: berry_bush
entries._comment: Berry bush cluster. Pink. Multiple anchors expected (one per cluster). Compiler emits each as a food_berry_bush instance.

entries.name: rock
entries._comment: Rock cluster. Mid-grey. Multiple anchors. Compiler emits as prop_stone instances.

entries.name: bridge
entries._comment: Bridge over water. Dark brown. Anchor at centroid; rotation aligned to water-crossing direction by downstream rule.
